result.description:
Key responsibilities
- Produce detailed shop drawings for benchtops, vanities, splashbacks, wall cladding and custom stone work from architectural plans, joinery drawings and site templates/digital measures (e.g. Laser/Proliner data).
- Convert approved drawings into CNC/saw-jet programs and nest layouts, optimising slab yield and accounting for vein matching, book-matching and slab defects.
- Detail edge profiles, cut-outs (sinks, cooktops, taps, power points), mitres, waterfall joins, joint locations, overhangs and support requirements.
- Check drawings against stone slab dimensions, thickness, transport limits and site access constraints.
- Liaise with sales/estimating, project managers, stonemasons, CNC operators and installers to resolve discrepancies before cutting.
- Issue drawings to clients/builders for sign-off, manage revisions and maintain version control.
- Maintain the drawing register, templates and CAD standards library.
- Support estimating with material take-offs and slab quantity calculations.
- Ensure compliance with AS/NZS standards, engineered-stone silica regulations and company QA procedures.
- Flag design risks (unsupported spans, thin sections, weak veining) and propose solutions.

Skills required
CAD proficiency (AutoCAD and stone-industry software such as Alphacam, Slabsmith, Titan/Moraware); ability to read architectural and joinery drawings; understanding of natural and engineered stone behaviour; strong attention to detail; clear communication with trades and clients.

The Client  

Smart Energy Group is a full-service renewable solar energy company servicing Australia wide. They design and install bespoke solar solutions that reduce the energy costs of Australian households and businesses whilst improving Australia's green footprint. 

They seek an experienced Sales Recruitment Manager to join their team in Byron Bay, NSW.  

 

 

The Role 

The Sales Recruitment Manager is responsible for leading Smart Energy’s national Lead Generation recruitment function, ensuring every office has the talent required to achieve its growth and performance targets. Working closely with the National Recruitment Manager, this role oversees the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, including workforce planning, talent attraction, candidate management, onboarding, retention, and recruitment team performance. 

This is for a full-time role with an annual salary base set $80,000 plus superannuation. This role will be based in their Byron Bay office. 

 

 

Responsibilities  

Manage end-to-end recruitment for Lead Generation roles nationally. 

Execute hiring plans aligned with business growth targets. 

Manage candidate pipelines through Lever ATS and sourcing platforms. 

Conduct interviews, assessments, and candidate screening. 

Coordinate onboarding and candidate experience. 

Build and maintain future talent pipelines. 

Create engaging job advertisements across Seek, Indeed, Facebook, LinkedIn, and additional sourcing channels. 

Develop attraction strategies targeting school leavers, backpackers, hospitality professionals, retail talent, athletes, and sales professionals. 

Manage recruitment campaigns and analyse performance metrics. 

Support the growth of Smart Energy's employer brand nationally. 

Forecast hiring requirements alongside Sales Managers and Regional Leaders. 

Monitor Lead Generator-to-Specialist ratios nationally. 

Proactively identify recruitment risks and staffing gaps. 

Support office expansion and new office launches. 

Monitor retention trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

Conduct new starter surveys and feedback sessions. 

Partner with operational leaders to improve onboarding outcomes. 

Analyse attrition and recommend solutions. 

Lead, coach, and support the Lead Generation recruitment team. 

Assist with daily recruitment meetings and training sessions. 

Support implementation of recruitment KPIs and performance expectations. 

Deliver recruitment reporting and hiring insights. 

Foster a high-performance recruitment culture focused on quality, accountability, and speed. 

Track and report on Time to Hire, Cost per Hire, Source Effectiveness, Retention Rates, and Recruitment Funnel Conversion Ratios. 

Use recruitment data and insights to drive continuous improvement and informed decision-making. 

 

 

Requirements 

At least 4 years experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or workforce planning, ideally within a high-volume, target-driven environment. 

At least 4 years managing end-to-end recruitment processes, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding. 

At least 4 years leadership or team management experience, with the ability to coach, develop, and hold recruiters accountable to performance targets. 

At least 4 years stakeholder management experience, partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to forecast hiring needs and deliver recruitment outcomes. 

At least 4 years experience in building and maintaining talent pipelines for high-growth or rapidly scaling businesses. 

Demonstrated ability to work with recruitment metrics, reporting, and workforce planning data to drive hiring decisions. 

At least 4 years experience creating and managing recruitment advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, including Seek, LinkedIn, Indeed, and social media channels. 

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple vacancies, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously. 

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence candidates and internal stakeholders alike.

JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company, employing thousands of people across the country. We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced IT Coordinator to join our team at JBS Dinmore.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about developing people, driving performance, and creating a strong culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

About the Role
As an IT Coordinator at Dinmore Plant, you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting all plant IT systems to ensure operational efficiency. This role includes installing and configuring hardware and software, performing preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting technical issues. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication with non-technical users, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment. The IT Coordinator plays a key role in minimising downtime, supporting continuous improvement, and ensuring reliable technology performance across the site. This is a full-time role with annual salary not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities include:
Perform preventative and scheduled maintenance on all plant IT assets to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Install and configure new hardware, including desktop computers and industrial printers, to support operational needs.
Deploy and configure software across multiple platforms, ensuring compatibility and functionality.
Modify, configure and customise existing software applications and system settings to meet operational requirements and improve user functionality and efficiency.
Assess software and hardware requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions to meet operational and user needs across the plant environment.
Configure, implement and maintain local computer networks and connectivity solutions to support business systems and operational equipment.
Assist with the design, maintenance and updating of internal web-based platforms, intranet resources or business websites to support operational and communication requirements.
Monitor, diagnose, and resolve daily IT issues throughout the plant, providing timely and effective support.
Troubleshoot and resolve user-related problems as they arise, minimising downtime and disruption.
Escalate complex issues to the broader IT support team while maintaining accountability for resolution and closure.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth IT operations.
Prepare reports and track data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus 1 year of full-time relevant experience. Alternatively, at least 3 years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualifications.
Previous experience working with varied IT hardware, software, and operating systems.
Ability to work autonomously as well as part of a greater team.
Highly developed interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills – with the ability to explain technical issues to a non-technical user base.
Highly developed time management skills, including prioritising tasks and meeting conflicting deadlines.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
High standard of computer literacy.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and diagnostic skills.
Previous experience in a food manufacturing/processing environment would be preferable.

What We Offer
Career development opportunities within a global organisation
Supportive leadership team and collaborative work environment
Access to employee benefits and wellbeing programs
Opportunity to make a genuine impact on workforce capability and employee success
Long-term career opportunities with one of Australia's leading employers
If you are passionate about developing people and want to be part of a business that values safety, teamwork and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

The ad is valid for 28 days.,

Apply now and help shape the future workforce at JBS Dinmore!

We have Trailer Mechanic/Heavy Duty Diesel Mechanic/Diesel Mechanic positions available across our various locations.  Main duties involve servicing, maintenance, and repairs on a variety of road transport vehicles and equipment at our local workshops.

Salaries are dependent on skills & experience -
•	Bruce Rock, WA, 6418 -  From $85,000 
•	Forrestfield, WA, 6058 - From $79,500 
•	Geraldton, WA, 6530 - From $85,000 
•	Port Hedland, WA, 6721 - from $105,000 

These positions are -
•	Full Time Permanent
•	Various rosters available
•	Tool Allowance $35.00 paid fortnightly
•	ASAP Start !

The key responsibilities for these roles include: 
•	Servicing and maintenance of trucks and trailers, as per client requirements
•	Trailer/truck assembly
•	Interpreting drawings and procedures.
•	Working on braking systems including ABS/EBS systems
•	Working with truck/trailer electrical, air and hydraulic systems
•	Working on hydraulics and PTO systems used in tippers and side tippers
•	Re-setting wheel alignment using modern 3D camera equipment

Required skills and experience: 
•	Any mechanical Trade Certification preferred - LV / HV / Fitters are encouraged to apply.
•	For non-Trade Certified applicants, 2-3 years experience required working on similar equipment.
•	Forklift ticket (high risk licence)
•	Have Australian working rights

About the Company:
Bruce Rock Engineering is a leading quality designer, builder and service provider of road transport equipment in Australia. We offer a complete range of trailer solutions to the agricultural, mining, construction and general freight industries nationwide. With the lightest tare weights in Australia, our innovative, high quality trailers are engineered for reliability, durability and performance.

Why work for Bruce Rock Engineering?
•	Great family-based values driven culture.
•	Join a growing, exciting, and professional business with opportunity for growth & career development.
•	Internal movement and progression across 4 sites around WA (Forrestfield, Bruce Rock, Port Hedland, and Geraldton).
•	Regular team BBQ's and active social club.
•	Gain industry-based training and experience, including Apprenticeship programs.
•	Financial support provided for external training.
•	Excellent working conditions, flexible hours, and shift options.
•	Access to salary packaging for your car with a novated lease - enjoy significant tax savings as well as GST savings on your car purchase, fuel, tyres, servicing, and maintenance.
•	Access to hundreds of everyday savings through Flare Benefits – exclusive discounts on well-known brands offering everything from groceries, phone bills, technology to fashion, restaurants, and entertainment.
•	Service recognition awards.
•	Employee of the Month and Employee of the Year program with great prizes.
•	Ability to participate in our Employee Referral Program (up to $5000 per referral!).
•	Mental health support and EAP services free of charge to you and your family

Job description

Fetch Recruitment is an Australian owned recruitment consultancy, delivering long term benefits to both our candidates and clients within the built environment. At Fetch, we passionate about empowering people to take charge of their careers and realize their potential, regardless of whether this is the candidates we partner with or colleagues in our team. We are looking for a highly driven and polished Business Development Manager committed to building a lasting network of candidates and clients. 


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Due to growth and a high client demand, we have a couple of opportunities for experienced Business Development Managers to join the team. We have opportunities within the engineering and the local government divisions. The role will include, but not limited to, the following responsibilities:
Developing growth strategies and plans
Managing and retaining relationships with existing clients
Increasing client base through canvass calling, use of marketing networking and lead generation
Identifying and mapping business strengths and customer needs
Strive to achieve maximum revenue for Fetch through effective objection handling and negotiation in line with company policy

ABOUT YOU
You may already be a Business Development Manager looking for a new exciting challenge or a hungry Senior Recruitment Consultant with BDM experience looking to prove your abilities.
Demonstrated experience working within the construction, engineering or local government sectors. Previous experience managing a 360 desk and developing new business Leadership qualities is desired but not essential. 
You will be required to have 3+ years experience in business to business sales. It is important you have excellent phone sales skills and experience interacting and building relationships with businesses and corporations.

WHY FETCH?

We are big on celebrating success and have a huge focus on our culture, just to list a few benefits:
Work alongside Industry leaders within Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire Recruitment
Global PSA Clients
LinkedIn Recruiter License
Highflyers Club
Quarterly Team Building
Networking functions
Yearly team trips away
Access to 6 extra annual leave days
End of month events
Quarterly awards
Microsoft Surface Pro & iPhone
Flexible working from home policy
Modern office in central Southbank location, walking distance from Flinders St Station


We will offer you fast development, support, strong internal and external training and various opportunities. You will benefit from a high salary and a very rewarding commission structure but for that we are looking for the best successful and proven sales professionals.

If you are looking for an opportunity to progress your career within a successful expanding agency, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Please check us out at www.fetchrecruitment.com.au
